title: DAC AC Measurement
text: Measure AC performance metrics of DAC output, 3 inputs; {Digital signal frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of digital input signal to DAC, {Start conversion frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of internal start conversion clock, {Settling time tolerance (LSB)} sets the tolerance for calculating settling time, {Hold off time (s)} sets the delay before measurement analysis to avoid corruption, {Recommended simulation stop time (s)} sets the minimum time simulation must run for meaningful, {Output result to base workspace} sets the store detailed test results to base, {Workspace variable name} sets the name of the variable that stores detailed test results and {Show spectrum analyzer during simulation} sets the displays Spectrum Analyzer during. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: digital
ports.summary: Digital input signal from DAC scalar

ports.name: analog
ports.summary: Converted analog signal from DAC scalar

ports.name: start
ports.summary: External clock to start conversion scalar

params.name: Digital signal frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of digital input signal to DAC 1e3 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Start conversion frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of internal start conversion clock 1e6 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Settling time tolerance (LSB)
params.values: Tolerance for calculating settling time 0.5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Hold off time (s)
params.values: Delay before measurement analysis to avoid corruption by transients 0 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Recommended simulation stop time (s)
params.values: Minimum time simulation must run for meaningful result 0.09 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Output result to base workspace
params.values: Store detailed test results to base workspace off (default) | on

params.name: Workspace variable name
params.values: Name of the variable that stores detailed test results dac_ac_out (default) | character string

params.name: Show spectrum analyzer during simulation
params.values: Displays Spectrum Analyzer during simulation on (default) | off
